sql.query: INSERT INTO tb_kabm_faq (category_cd, use_yn, question,answer,reg_ddtm, reg_emp_cd) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?,getdate(),?)
UPDATE tb_kabm_faq SET category_cd = ?, use_yn = ?, question = ?, answer = ? WHERE faq_no = ?

SELECT a.faq_no,a.category_cd, a.use_yn, a.question, a.answer, CONVERT(varchar(10), a.reg_ddtm,120) reg_ddtm, a.reg_emp_cd, d.emp_nm emp_nm FROM tb_kabm_faq a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_kabm_emp d ON a.reg_emp_cd = d.emp_cd WHERE a.faq_no = ?

SELECT TOP (?) faq_no, category_cd, category_nm, use_yn, question, answer, CONVERT(varchar(10), reg_ddtm,120) reg_ddtm, reg_emp_cd, emp_nm, num, tot_cnt FROM ( SELECT a.faq_no, a.category_cd, b.cd_nm category_nm, a.use_yn, a.question, a.answer, a.reg_ddtm, a.reg_emp_cd, d.emp_nm emp_nm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by a.reg_ddtm desc) num, count(*) over() tot_cnt FROM tb_kabm_faq a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_kabm_emp d ON a.reg_emp_cd = d.emp_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_kabm_code b ON a.category_cd = b.cd and b.div_cd = 'faq_category' WHERE $dynamic_sql AND (CASE ? WHEN '' THEN '0' ELSE a.category_cd END = CASE ? WHEN '' THEN '0' ELSE ? END ) AND (CASE ? WHEN '' THEN '0' ELSE a.use_yn END = CASE ? WHEN '' THEN '0' ELSE ? END ) ) x WHERE num > (? -1) * ?

mapping.getProperty: faq_no, category_cd, category_nm, use_yn, question, answer, reg_ddtm, reg_emp_cd, emp_nm, num, tot_cnt

sql.query: SELECT TOP (?) faq_no, category_cd, category_nm, use_yn, question, answer, CONVERT(varchar(10), reg_ddtm,120) reg_ddtm, reg_emp_cd, emp_nm, num, tot_cnt FROM ( SELECT a.faq_no, a.category_cd, b.cd_nm category_nm, a.use_yn, a.question, a.answer, a.reg_ddtm, a.reg_emp_cd, d.emp_nm emp_nm, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by a.reg_ddtm desc) num, count(*) over() tot_cnt FROM tb_kabm_faq a LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_kabm_emp d ON a.reg_emp_cd = d.emp_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_kabm_code b ON a.category_cd = b.cd and b.div_cd = 'faq_category' WHERE a.use_yn = 'Y' AND ( a.question LIKE '%'+?+'%' OR a.answer LIKE '%'+?+'%' ) ) x WHERE num > (? -1) * ?

mapping.getProperty: faq_no, category_cd, category_nm, use_yn, question, answer, reg_ddtm, reg_emp_cd, emp_nm, num, tot_cnt
